title: Argentinian Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Argentina, featuring tender beef and nutritious vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, carrot, potato, and parsnip. Cook until the vegetables are slightly tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, red wine, beef broth, thyme, and bay leaves. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Braise the stew in a preheated oven at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
